rust_equivalent: crates/archive/src/conductor.rs (stripped channel identity builder retaining recording transport/session parameters)

crates/archive/src/archive_counters.rs (Rust CountersManager replaces Aeron Counter mocks and omits Java version metadata)

crates/archive/src/archive_mark_file.rs (SBE mark-file header identity, aligned file sizing, metadata/channel round-trips, liveness signaling, archive ID, error-buffer access, and reopen persistence; upstream migration, Mockito force-order, and process-ownership cases remain outside the current boundary)
crates/archive/tests/migration_utils.rs (legacy v2 mark-file and 1024-byte catalog-frame fixture builders with descriptor validity and size guards)

crates/archive/src/migration.rs and crates/archive/tests/archive_migration.rs (v2.1.0 mark/catalog conversion to the current catalog format, descriptor gaps and invalid-state preservation, v3.0.0 mark versioning, and migration timestamp guard)

crates/archive/src/recording_descriptor.rs and crates/archive/tests/archive_tests.rs, crates/archive/tests/runtime_lifecycle.rs, crates/archive/tests/control_service.rs (recording-name/segment math, non-zero-start recovery, shared-subscription listing, lifecycle/restart/replay, URI filtering, and control-service behavior; upstream AeronArchive buffer ownership, authorization, archive-ID multiplexing, control-channel-disabled mode, and client-state cases remain outside the current Rust boundary)

crates/archive/tests/control_service.rs (archive-dir lifecycle helper plus await_resources, await_response, await_listing, await_recordings, and await_subscription_listing helpers used by real control-plane tests; Rust helpers are test-local rather than a shared Java utility class)

crates/archive/src/archive_tool.rs and crates/archive/tests/archive_tool_cli.rs (bounded describe and describe-all catalog inspection, including valid/invalid filtering and unknown recording errors; upstream mark-file output, repair, dump, verify, and lifecycle commands remain outside the current Rust boundary)

crates/archive/src/service.rs and crates/archive/src/archive_tool.rs with crates/archive/tests/archive_tool_separate_mark_file.rs (separate mark-file directory, archive-mark.lnk creation/resolution, and describe/describe-all inspection; upstream capacity mutation and full mark-file reporting remain outside the current Rust boundary)
crates/archive/src/control_session_adapter.rs (pure Rust adapter decode for ReplicateRequest2, Replay, BoundedReplay, and ReplayTokenRequest)
crates/archive/src/control_session_adapter.rs (pure Rust v6 shortened-block decode for Replay, BoundedReplay, and ReplicateRequest2 with Aeron null-value defaults)
crates/archive/src/control_session.rs (Rust adaptation of ControlSession lifecycle, abort reason, active-listing cancellation, and warning classification)
crates/archive/src/delete_segments_session.rs (Rust delete-session queue, segment-position parsing, and close signal)
crates/archive/src/list_recording_by_id_session.rs (single-recording descriptor retry, missing/invalid recording-unknown response, invalidation between retries, and close)
crates/archive/src/list_recordings_for_uri_session.rs (bounded stream/channel-filtered scanning, descriptor retry, and recording-unknown exhaustion response)
crates/archive/src/list_recordings_session.rs (incremental descriptor listing, missing-recording response, and abort behavior)

crates/archive/tests/runtime_lifecycle.rs (real ArchiveRuntime image-frame recording, segment-file creation, stop persistence, and replay payload coverage; Java mock event-proxy wiring is outside the Rust runtime API)

crates/archive/src/runtime.rs (RecordingWriter frame validation, file writes, and segment rollover; checksum, padding-frame, and interrupt-injection paths are outside the current runtime configuration)

crates/archive/tests/runtime_lifecycle.rs and crates/archive/tests/control_service.rs (ReplayCursor active follow, stopped replay, persistence, bounded limits, and control-plane publication behavior; Java-specific CRC/padding publication mechanics remain outside the cursor API)
crates/archive/src/checksum.rs (Rust generic constructor replaces Java reflection)

crates/archive/src/client_context.rs (control-channel session-ID/default injection and retry-attempt validation; high-level connection ownership and close orchestration remain outside the current Rust client API)
crates/archive/src/recording_pos.rs (Rust CountersManager-backed recording-position metadata and lookup)
